description:

Tamayoshi is a Tamagotchi like gas-less on chain mobile game. So it's FREE TO PLAY!

The game involves taking care of a Tamayoshi virtual pet, which can grow. Are actions are stored on-chain, and players can interact with it by feeding, playing, or performing other actions.

Each square represents an action
Green: Start a game and keeps track of their points
Pink: Your pet avatar, clicking will change their personality
Orange: Your pet's last action, eating, napping or running
Red (eat): Click to feed your pet. 
Yellow (nap): Click to put your pet to sleep
Blue (run): Click to exercise your pet
